{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ministry of Industry''' was a Ministry under the purview of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Civil Government]]. It controlled the Alliance's industrial output, from the few heavy factories on [[Safe world/Legends|safe worlds]] and Alliance planets such as [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], to the small cottage industry factories hidden throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The larger factories produced the war materiel that could not be easily acquired, such as [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]], while the smaller ones churned out [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], small arms, and clothing.
